Played for about 6 hours so far and I’m really enjoying Peak, especially when playing with friends. It’s fun and engaging, but the difficulty can spike pretty hard at times, making some parts feel tougher than expected. Still, the challenge keeps it interesting, and I’m keen to keep improving as I play more.

+ Regular updates
+ Good team play
-+ Entertainment for a few hours, but no more
- Controls are sometimes imprecise and annoying to use

I can recommend this game if you have other people to play with. The price/performance ratio is good, but it really shouldn't be any more expensive, as there are clearly more well-rounded co-op games with more content

I really want to love this game more. It's a great concept, well executed as far as the gameplay is concerned, and it's loads of fun overall.

HOWEVER.

I have not been able to launch this game a single time without it crashing upwards of 10-20 times before getting into a game in a stable state. Launch the game, get to the publisher logos, immediately crash. Try again, get to the main menu, crash. Try again, game doesnt even open before it crashes. I would love to play this game with friends, I would love to not make people wait 30 minutes for me to be able to even launch the game, but I can't.

I don't think I can recommend this game in it's current state, as it will only lead to immense frustrations and feeling like you wasted $7

harrible. New patch made the game look significantly worse, with poor dither transparency, really poor dithering on shadows, really poor LOD pop ins, etc. You can see the edge of the cliff you are mounting on top of get an LOD pop in right in front of you. The game is meant to be this "daily" challenge sort of thing but it takes about 2 hours. The biggest issue by far is the procedural generation of the terrain ends up really screwing you, because you hit dead ends very often and need to backtrack, and there's no mechanic in the game that lets you scout ahead.

I was surprised by PEAK. I saw at first, a cute, seemingly chill game to play with your friends. What I got was a cute game with brutal survivalism, intense climbing and play so challenging it will quickly turn any group without discipline and patience into a puddle of goo at the bottom of a ravine. I play a lot of survival games and PEAK is perhaps the best of them. Your enemy is not just the mountain you must climb, but your own carelessness, greed and poor planning can end any run really fast. Its a high risk, high reward game and I'm here for it.

One of the best games that you can play with your friends or with your partner. if you really enjoy legend of Zelda breath of the wild/ tears of the kingdom climbing then this game is for you. My wife and I really love it so much.

This game is just pure fun. The gameplay + community vibe makes it honestly one of the funniest experiences I’ve had with friends. It’s like 99% teamwork, and the voice chat is so good that I ended up muting Discord just to use the in-game one 😂 The echo in the caves when your teammates shout is chef’s kiss.

The achievements are another genius touch — I’ve already finished all of them (for now 👀) and I can’t wait for more to come, because they actually made me replay the game again and again, and it never felt boring.

Bugs? Honestly none worth mentioning. For a game still in development, it feels super solid.

So far, I’ve spent 54.8 hours in PEAK! and I’ve enjoyed every single one.
I already convinced 6 of my friends (including my girlfriend 💕) to grab it, and we’ve had such a good time together. If you’re looking for a game to laugh, team up, and create hilarious moments with friends or even as a couple — this is the one. Highly recommend it.
